description: This file defines a page agent module for Playwright, including functions for performing, expecting, and extracting data from web pages, with caching and loop control features.

methods.name: pageAgentPerform
methods.description: Performs a user task on the page using tools, with caching and loop control.

methods.name: pageAgentExpect
methods.description: Verifies or asserts a condition on the page using tools, with caching.

methods.name: pageAgentExtract
methods.description: Extracts information from the page based on a query schema.

methods.name: runLoop
methods.description: Runs a loop to perform actions or extract data, managing API calls, caching, and error handling.

methods.name: cachedPerform
methods.description: Retrieves cached actions and executes them if available.

methods.name: updateCache
methods.description: Updates the cache with new actions after performing tasks.

methods.name: cachedActions
methods.description: Loads cached actions from a cache file, with validation.
